name: com.oauth.onesdk.view.autoLogin.oneSDKAutoLoginView
description: When saved sign-in details are available and automatic sign-in is requested, the CIBMall or PlayID OneSDK account SDK opens this page. It checks the saved account with the service and returns the sign-in result.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents saved-account sign-in from completing, so the user may remain signed out.
